name: Muted.
source:
One night, everything was plunged into darkness. And when words were spoken... he couldn't hear them... but he knew what they were saying.

What happened? And is there a way to reverse it?

[From [url=https://tofu-sheets-visual.itch.io/muted]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一夜之间，一切陷入黑暗。当说话时……他听不见……但他知道他们在说什么。

发生了什么？有没有办法扭转它？

[来自[url=https://tofu-sheets-visual.itch.io/muted]Itch.io[/url]]
